description.summary: You play an elemental song, crippling your enemies by lowering their resistance to elemental spells and effects.
description.value: You play an elemental song, crippling your enemies by lowering their resistance to elemental spells and effects. The bard chooses an element type: dark, earth, fire, ice, light, lightning, water, or wind. Each round this song is in effect, enemies within 30 feet of the bard suffer a – 6 penalty to Saving Throws against Elemental (of the chosen type) spells and effects as well as reduces elemental (of the chosen type) resistance by –1 5.
